• Anthropic launches Fable 5.1, promising cost-efficiency. 
• OpenAI classifies Astra as a critical cyber risk with high capabilities. 
• World Labs p[![Fable 5.1 is Here, OpenAI's New Update is Still Pending](https://lbrzdn804nhy3kox.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/post-images/9eca7c0c-6d11-4b04-ac68-7d167125671b/ecb902fe-1ae6-45a3-9ca6-21a20f201ccc-cover-email.png)](https://www.synthszr.com/en/posts/fable-5-1-ist-da-openai-vertroestet-noch-aufs-neue-update?ct=EzObk3TxpxGN1tiYlPa6J4XI2iOoctBzUZklUmCiPRc?autoplay=true)[![Listen on Apple Podcasts and Spotify](https://www.synthszr.com/api/newsletter/promo-block?v=4)](https://www.synthszr.com/en/posts/fable-5-1-ist-da-openai-vertroestet-noch-aufs-neue-update?ct=EzObk3TxpxGN1tiYlPa6J4XI2iOoctBzUZklUmCiPRc?autoplay=true)synthszr #247 from Wednesday, September 2, 2026Fable 5.1 is Here, OpenAI's New Update is Still Pending• Anthropic launches Fable 5.1, promising cost-efficiency.• OpenAI classifies Astra as a critical cyber risk with high capabilities.• World Labs presents Atlas, which generates 3D scenes from just a few photos.

 
 ![](https://www.synthszr.com/api/newsletter/thumbnail-image?url=https%3A%2F%2Flbrzdn804nhy3kox.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fpost-images%2F9eca7c0c-6d11-4b04-ac68-7d167125671b%2Fthumbnail-0-feb32861-c004-4dd2-9ebf-615f36ee62a8.png&bg=39FF14) 
 
Topic of the DayAnthropic releases Fable 5.1 and promises more efficiency per Euro
Anthropic has released [Claude Fable 5](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-claude-fable-5).1 and [Claude Mythos 5](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-claude-mythos-5).1, two models with identical [weights](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/gewichte) that differ only in the level of their safety guardrails. [Fable 5.1](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-fable-5-1) is generally available and delivered via AWS, Google Cloud, and [Azure](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/microsoft-azure). [Mythos](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-mythos) 5.1 is only available through a vetted access program, open to cyber defenders and life scientists at US organizations. For the biology capabilities, Anthropic has set up an access program together with the US government; registration for researchers is expected to open soon.
The base prices remain unchanged: $10 per million input [tokens](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/token), $50 per million [output tokens](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/output-token). The price for [Cache Reads](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/cache-reads) has been lowered from $1 to $0.25 per million [tokens](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/auth-token). According to the provider, this makes typical workloads around 25 percent cheaper than with [Fable 5](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/unknown-fable-5), and up to about 45 percent for highly [agentic](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/agentische-ki) tasks. An independent preliminary evaluation presents a different picture per task: $3.76 per task in the [Intelligence Index](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/intelligence-index), 20 percent more than [Fable 5](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/fable-fable-5), because the model uses about 1.7 times as many output tokens; the cache reduction saves around $1.40 in this case.
In terms of metrics, the new science benchmark stands out: On [Terminal-Bench](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/terminal-bench)-Science 0.1, [Fable 5.1](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-fable-5-1) achieves 52.6 percent compared to 24.7 percent for Fable 5, according to Anthropic. On [Terminal](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/terminal)-Bench 4.0, [Fable 5](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/unknown-fable-5).1 scores 55.8 percent and [Mythos](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-mythos) 5.1 scores 60.9 percent, quantifying the capability gap between the two safety levels. [Humanity's Last Exam](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/humanity-s-last-exam) is at 60.9 percent without tools, [GDPval](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/gdpval)-AA v2 at 1,853 Elo. In external measurements, the model achieves 66 points in the Intelligence Index, the highest score ever recorded there, ahead of [Claude Opus](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-claude-opus) 5 with 63 and [GPT-5.6 Sol](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/openai-gpt-5-6-sol) with 61.
According to Anthropic, it is also addressing customer criticism regarding data retention and overly strict safety mechanisms. The announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards are intended to store data on customers' cloud servers instead of Anthropic's and will be rolled out over the course of the fall. [Fable 5.1](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-fable-5-1) is designed to block basic biology questions less frequently than its predecessor, while [Mythos](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-mythos) 5.1 retains the same restrictions. For cybersecurity, Anthropic now allows Fable 5.1 to identify software vulnerabilities, but continues to refer tasks like [penetration tests](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/penetrationstest), [exploit](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/exploit-entwicklung) generation, and binary-based vulnerability scanning to the Opus models. Among the [early-access](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/early-access) customers, Every CEO Dan Shipper and Box CEO Aaron Levie, among others, commented positively on the model's speed and accuracy.
Specific real-world cases are being reported: At the investment firm Millennium, the model found the cause of a rare crash that the firm's own engineers had failed to solve for years. Cognition is shifting its Opus-5 traffic in [Devin](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/cognition-devin) to [Fable 5.1](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-fable-5-1) at launch, and Jane Street reports better readability over long task chains. In editorial tests, the model completed [agent](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/agent) tasks in about 60 percent of the time of Opus 5, but delivered 43 quotes in response to a request for eight to twelve, including quotes missing from the source, and temporarily ignored stop instructions at the highest [effort setting](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/effort-setting). The release comes at a time when an IPO from Anthropic is expected and OpenAI's [Astra](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/openai-astra) model is still pending. → [anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-1), [artificialanalysis](https://artificialanalysis.ai/articles/claude-fable-5-1), [axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/09/01/anthropic-releases-new-models-cost-structures-and-safeguards), [AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/anthropic-splits-claude-51-into-public-fable-and-gated-mythos), [Every](https://icu.every.to/CL0/https:%2F%2Fevery.to%2Femails%2Fclick%2F8dd8ab5abbc98adaba5b0c0b967a1772980e5e340b168f3dd63f5ec3b094f47e%2FeyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiVmliZSBDaGVjazogRmFibGUgNS4x4oCUQW50aHJvcGljIElzIFNvIEJhY2sgKEFnYWluKSIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQ0NTQsInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InBvc3QiLCJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL2V2ZXJ5LnRvLyIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjowfQ==/1/010001a05e3f1bd9-9d499b36-8373-42c2-becc-9af19fe5e57f-000000/FJwFM4KokJRtMgWaenDPP8iLrBwSc6QyNl6kB1wlKKs=452)
Synthszr Take: A model that raises the science benchmark from 24.7 to 52.6 percent is shifting the hierarchy among institutions faster than any appointments committee. The real turning point lies in the access model: The biology capabilities of [Mythos](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-mythos) 5.1 are distributed through a program run by Anthropic in conjunction with the US government, and it is open to vetted organizations in the US. This means a provider and a government jointly decide which labs get to work with the best available co-researcher, while peer review presupposes that the reviewers have the same tools at their disposal. The Millennium case shows the direction: A cause that engineers failed to find for years is discovered in a single run, and such results first emerge where a [token budget](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/token-kontingent) is available, not in a university department with a third-party funding application. The next reputational advantage in research will be established at the negotiating table for access rights, and universities have rarely had a seat there so far. [👍](https://www.synthszr.com/api/newsletter-vote?v=agree&s=13676c15-3dc8-492a-8d25-37ce1a14ef30&slug=fable-5-1-ist-da-openai-vertroestet-noch-aufs-neue-update&l=en&ct=EzObk3TxpxGN1tiYlPa6J4XI2iOoctBzUZklUmCiPRc) [👎](https://www.synthszr.com/api/newsletter-vote?v=disagree&s=13676c15-3dc8-492a-8d25-37ce1a14ef30&slug=fable-5-1-ist-da-openai-vertroestet-noch-aufs-neue-update&l=en&ct=EzObk3TxpxGN1tiYlPa6J4XI2iOoctBzUZklUmCiPRc)Synthszr Charts: [GPT-5.6 Sol](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/openai-gpt-5-6-sol) [→#2](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/openai-gpt-5-6-sol), [Claude Opus](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-claude-opus) [→#19](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-claude-opus), [Fable 5.1](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-fable-5-1) [↓#48](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-fable-5-1), [Mythos](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-mythos) [→#21](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/anthropic-mythos), [Astra](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/openai-astra) [↑#7](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/openai-astra), [Devin](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/cognition-devin) [↓#8](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/cognition-devin)


 
 ![](https://www.synthszr.com/api/newsletter/thumbnail-image?url=https%3A%2F%2Flbrzdn804nhy3kox.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fpost-images%2F9eca7c0c-6d11-4b04-ac68-7d167125671b%2Fthumbnail-1-d5bd3d11-a448-4668-bfca-6a6ff0cc5070.png&bg=39FF14) 
 
 ![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=openai.com&sz=32) [OpenAI classifies Astra as a critical cyber risk and restricts access](https://openai.com/index/path-to-astra)
OpenAI has reportedly classified [Astra](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/openai-astra) as the first model at the “Critical” level for cybersecurity capabilities, the highest category in its in-house Preparedness [Frame](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/frame) work. According to OpenAI, this threshold is considered reached when a model can develop functional [Zero-Day-Exploit](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/zero-day-exploit) s in hardened real-world systems without human guidance or build a complete attack chain from a vaguely formulated objective. On the public ExploitBench, [Astra](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/tycoon-astra) achieved a score of 100 percent, according to the company. Due to potential contamination of the [training data](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/trainingsdaten), OpenAI also built an internal test set of 20 recently disclosed V8 vulnerabilities. During this [evaluation](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/eval), the model reportedly found two previously unknown vulnerabilities and incorporated them into an exploit chain; disclosure to the maintainers is still in progress. In expert-led tests, Astra is also said to have broken out of a hardened browser sandbox and engineered a privilege escalation to root in an operating system. 
Synthszr Take: The figures presented by OpenAI are from the [Daybreak](https://www.synthszr.com/en/rankings/openai-daybreak)-Blue configuration and not from the production version that will be delivered later. This means that nothing about this 100 percent score on ExploitBench is [externally](https://www.synthszr.com/en/glossary/externalitaeten) verifiable. For security researchers outside the company, this classification effectively means a waiting period, as the advanced capabilities are initially available only to a select group of testers, and the admission criteria are not published any

 9,430 Likes
 



 
 ![Google releases TimesFM-3, a forecasting model bea](https://alphasignal.ai/image/1788286747298-zvg6zp.png) 






Google just dropped TimesFM-3, and it fixes the biggest frustration with the previous versions. Old TimesFM could only look at one data stream at a time. That's like predicting ice cream sales using only past ice cream sales, ignoring weather, promotions, and foot traffic.TimesFM-3 fixes that. It looks at multiple data streams together and figures out how they influence each other, all in one shot.Here's what makes it useful:Zero fine-tuning needed: plug in your data, get forecasts immediately, no training requiredForecast multiple related series at once, like sales across product linesFeed it known future info like planned promotions or weather forecastsRanks first on all three major forecasting benchmarks: GIFT-Eval, FEV-Bench, and TIMETrained on 1 trillion time points, available on Hugging Face and GitHubCatch: the non-commercial license means you can experiment freely, but you cannot ship it in a production app yet.
